composer.notifyActive: Notify the people who are active
composer.hint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line. /remind me in 1h to …
composer.remindHelp: Try: /remind me in 1h to call Ana, or /remind me tomorrow at 9 to send the report

message.editHint: Esc to cancel, Enter to save

thread.title: Thread

thread.unfollowed: You will no longer be notified of replies

search.title: Search
search.label: Search messages
search.help: Filters: in:#channel, in:@person, from:@person or from:me, has:link, has:file, has:pin, has::emoji:, is:saved, is:thread, before:, after:, on: and during: with dates like 2026-10-25, "exact phrase" and -word.
search.emptyBody: Try other words or remove a filter.

views.threadsDesc: Threads you started, replied to or were mentioned in
views.threadsEmptyBody: Reply to a message in a thread to keep the conversation in one place.
views.activityEmptyBody: When someone mentions you, it shows up here.
views.laterEmptyBody: Save a message with the star or set a reminder from its menu.
views.draftsEmptyBody: What you write and do not send is kept here. Schedule a message with the clock next to Send.
views.filesDesc: Files shared in your channels and conversations
views.filesEmptyBody: Attach files to a message with the clip, by pasting or dragging them.

browse.title: Channels
browse.desc: Public channels of the workspace and the private ones you are in
browse.emptyBody: Create a channel or change the search.

dialogs.willBe: It will be #{name}: lowercase, no spaces.
dialogs.publicHelp: Anyone in the workspace can find and join it
dialogs.privateHelp: Only invited people can see it
dialogs.dmHelp: Pick one person for a direct message or up to 9 for a group. With nobody, it opens your own notes.
dialogs.issueHelp: The description takes the message text and a link back to it.
dialogs.noProjects: There are no Track teams yet. Create one in Track first.
dialogs.shareHelp: Track issues, CRM deals and Docs pages show a card with their status to whoever can open them.
dialogs.deleteMessageBody: It can't be undone. Files attached to it are deleted too.

details.nameHelp: Only the creator or an admin can rename it.
details.makePrivateHelp: Current members stay. It disappears from the directory for everyone else.
details.deleteBody: All messages and files are deleted for everyone. It cannot be undone. Archiving keeps the history.
details.archiveBody: Nobody can post in it, and the history stays searchable. You can restore it later.
details.leavePrivateBody: To come back to a private channel, someone in it has to add you again.
details.hooksHelp: Incoming webhooks post into this channel with a POST with a JSON "text" field to a secret URL, like Slack incoming webhooks. Outgoing: workspace webhooks and Flow get the "Message in a channel" event.
details.hookUrl: Copy this URL now: it is shown only once
details.flowHelp: In Flow, use the "Talk: message in a channel" trigger and the "Talk: send message" action. The API v1 has /api/v1/talk/channels and /api/v1/talk/messages with the talk:read and talk:write scopes.

status.title: Status and availability
status.dndUntil: Notifications paused until {when}. No emails go out meanwhile.

prefs.title: Talk preferences
prefs.keywordsHelp: Separated by commas. A message with any of them notifies you like a mention.
prefs.email_mentions: Mentions and direct messages I haven't read after 2 minutes
prefs.dndHelp: No push or email in that window, in your profile's time zone. The bell still collects everything.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.jump: Jump to a channel or conversation

guests.youAreGuest: You're a guest here: you only see the channels you were invited to.
guests.invitedNoEmail: Invitation created, but the email couldn't be sent
guests.inviteHelp: Guests only see the channels you pick. They don't see the channel directory, other channels or the rest of the apps.
guests.adminHelp: People from outside the team with access to specific channels. Removing one takes away their access right away.
guests.removeBody: They lose access to every channel and their notifications right away. Their DMs stay readable for the others.
guests.inviteToChannel: Invite a guest to this channel

profile.fieldsHelp: Fields everyone can fill in on their profile, like team or office.
